textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 3 evs · Food We Eat · Textbook Concepts
textbookBox.concept: We all like to eat and drink many different things. Some foods are sweet, some are sour, some are spicy and some are bitter. We eat fruits and vegetables, and we eat rice, dal or roti.

1.tip: Look closely at the diagram on the board as we explain each property.

beats.en: We all like to eat and drink many different things. Some foods are sweet, some are sour, some are spicy and some are bitter. We eat fruits and vegetables, and we eat rice, dal or roti. We drink milk, lassi and juice.
beats.speakEn: We all like to eat and drink many different things. Some foods are sweet, some are sour, some are spicy and some are bitter. We eat fruits and vegetables, and we eat rice, dal or roti. We drink milk, lassi and juice.

beats.en: Shirin was in class 3, and she ran faster than everyone in her class. One day at a school sports event she met a champion runner who had won many medals. Shirin asked, How can I run like you and win medals?

textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 3 evs · Food We Eat · Deeper Textbook Ideas
textbookBox.concept: The champion told Shirin to eat different kinds of vegetables and fruits. She told her to eat things made from different grains like rice, ragi, jowar, wheat and bajra.

beats.en: Elders cook different foods in summer and in winter. When it is hot, we love kulfi, ice-cream and tender coconut water. In winter we like warm food, soups, stew and hot drinks.

textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 3 evs · Food We Eat · Complete Summary
textbookBox.concept: In summer the weather is hot and we sweat a lot. When we sweat we lose water from our body, so we must drink more water, buttermilk, lime water, aam panna, sugarcane juice or tender coconut water.

beats.en: Let us review the key takeaway from Food We Eat: In summer the weather is hot and we sweat a lot. When we sweat we lose water from our body, so we must drink more water, buttermilk, lime water, aam panna, sugarcane juice or tender coconut water.
